name: @aphrody/monorepo
description: aphrody polyglot monorepo — Bun workspace root (first-party TypeScript/JS under apps/*). Rust=crates/ (cargo), Go=go/ (go.work), Python=python/ (uv). Unified runner: justfile. UI forks under packages/* (material-web, ui, tailwindcss) keep their native package managers (npm/pnpm) and are NOT bun workspace members.
